title: Fix more spelling errors in the docbook folder.
description:
There are some lines that show as changed in 'git gui', will see how
they look in gitlab..

notes.body: I have looked at the lines where some extra diffs appeared. The diff in gitlab highlights space characters, but when I copy/paste them they are both the standard space character - 32 (0x20).
